procedure: EA-NEGONT-02 v0.9 §3.4 D/R/O (working; not frozen). Admission by reading: D, a claim on Metawatch, Metawatch named; R, a relation the archive states between the IPTC's work (its metadata standard, Metawatch) or the class and an archive object; O, an archive category applied to the IPTC's metadata (O-direct) or to a class the field sources for the entity (O-class): content provenance in media, embedded photo metadata and C2PA Content Credentials (B5, B1, B2; census lineage 'media'), and metadata stripped in a publishing or processing pipeline (B1, B4; census transformations_tested). A bare mention, a list of anchors or keywords, a reference entry or a heading is not a claim; metadata stripping on another substrate (DOI records, YAML frontmatter, text deposits) is not the class.

verdicts.reason: Provenance After AI (EA-MPAI-PROVENANCE-01 v1.1): applies its dimensions of provenance to the class (content provenance in media): C2PA / Content Credentials as the artifact dimension, verifying the file at creation, its adoption uneven and its ingredient assertions under-adopted; the independence of the dimensions; the signed image whose caption loses the photographer's name; and, O-direct, 'IPTC AI metadata' as Layer 1 metadata, 'Disclosure, not lineage' (l. 260, not returned by the string pass: the table is one sentence past the 900-character cut). The string pass's D candidate (D0001) is the reference list ('IPTC 2025.1 AI metadata fields'), a bare listing, not a claim; Metawatch is not named.
the same work as #725 (v1.1, blog-canonical recovery, 2026-05-12): every claim falls in #725's lineages and adds nothing (S4); kept as an instance under #725, the earliest (2026-05-08)

EA-SPXI-ANALOG-01 (machine-eligible handwritten artifacts): R, the archive's own artifacts embed IPTC Creator (author or heteronym), Credit, CopyrightNotice and the rest, with XMP and C2PA, declare nonsynthetic capture by IPTC DigitalSourceType, and keep a triple metadata redundancy; O, embedded IPTC photo metadata as ingestion channel C4 ('scaffold the pipeline provably reads'), the membrane that 'survives … metadata stripping' (O-class, the stripping class), the IPTC and C2PA vocabularies as 'the same insight arriving as standards', and C2PA's trust anchor against content derivation. The leak-vector checklist (D0006), the AIA-2 certification checklist (D0015, R0003), the tier table (D0011, R0002, O0084), the field-map adoption (D0010, O0083) and the reference entry 'IPTC.' (D0017) are listings or restate the file layer (S4 under R1409-01) and are not ledgered apart.

The Photograph of the Handwritten Original, §6.1 'C2PA — the incumbent, and the essential comparison': C2PA 'attests what a device reports having done', validation not required by the specification, complementary to content-derived identifiers; the P.Sapph.Obbink exemplum (O0089, 'the human C2PA') is an analogy carried by the same section and is not ledgered apart

found by the hop (reverse, from #1409 and #1443; H-candidate): The Analog Advance's incumbency ring: C2PA 'secures the camera's testimony, not the author's', dependent on certificate authorities and platform adoption. The string pass's O-class sentence (O0090, the description's list of the ring) is a listing

Provenance Is What Authorship Must Endure: the three-layer table (artifact provenance: the file; C2PA, Content Credentials, signing; 'Necessary, insufficient') and 'C2PA prevents forgery; it does not constitute authorship.'
the same work as #729 (2026-05-14): the same table and sentence; instance under #729 (S4)

provenanceerasure.org definition surface: process provenance as 'The third dimension alongside artifact provenance (C2PA) and semantic provenance (PER)'; the artifact dimension restated, adds nothing to #729's lineage on the class (S4); instance under #729
Autonomous Semantic Warfare: C2PA standards and watermarking have not 'achieved sufficient adoption to function as infrastructure'
The $650 Billion Gap: C2PA addresses media provenance, 'narrowly scoped'; 'C2PA cannot tell you what was lost' when an article becomes an AI Overview
Gravity Well Protocol Specification: 'Against C2PA: C2PA authenticates media. Doesn't cover text …'

The Compression Arsenal v2.1: 'This is "semantic provenance" — what C2PA cannot provide' (O0002) falls in #621's and #725's lineage on what C2PA does not provide and adds nothing (S4); the Gravity Well analogies (O0003, O0004: 'open (like C2PA)', 'like Adobe for C2PA') are not claims on the class
The Compression Arsenal v2.0, the same text as #50 (instance)

SPXI-TLP v2.2, non-claim 2: robots.txt and C2PA 'operate primarily at the publication / legal / evidentiary layer rather than at the training-survival layer'. The c2pa-text paragraph (O0010) is on text, not media; the Tier-1 posting rule (O0011, 'XMP metadata if PDF') is the archive's own practice for PDFs and is not on the class

The Summarizer as Horizon of Reception (the Capture Registry's founding paper): provenance and attribution have reception consequences 'that existing metadata standards (Dublin Core, FAIR principles, C2PA) do not address'

AI-Native Intellectual Biography: provenance and attribution studies, C2PA among them, 'have focused on attribution loss in AI outputs'; the failure-mode table (O0045, 'Holographic Kernel as embedded metadata') is on text metadata, not the class
